name: B10-0547/2025 (S&D) – EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for strong support for a just and lasting peace in Ukraine. It says peace must respect Ukraine's independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity, and its right to choose its own alliances. It wants accountability for war crimes and Russian payments for the damage caused. It criticises US pressure on Ukraine to surrender and asks the EU to keep working with the United States and allies. This is the Parliament's position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is the Parliament's opinion and demand for action.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, Ukraine, the United States and Russia.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU leaders and Ukraine's government; no decision is binding.
